subQuests.subQuestName: Go and investigate the ancient ruins

20140201.text: This should be the place. But Sangonomiya was right, it doesn't look like anything suspicious is going on...

20140202.text: #Could they be hiding? {NICKNAME}, let's see what we can find.

20140203.text: These <color=#00E1FFFF>Electro Monuments</color> look a little suspicious...

20140502.text: As monsters go, that one was pretty tough. But what's such a huge Thunderhelm Lawachurl doing here in the first place?

20140503.text: It doesn't make any sense... Also, the atmosphere here gives Paimon the creeps.

20140504.text: Anyway, the good thing is that it's over now. We should probably get going... Huh, Teppei? What are you doing here?

20140505.text: *cough* ...Wow, this is a surprise. Didn't know you were the ones investigating here.

20140506.text: I just got back from delivering some supplies to the front line. I figured I'd stop by and clear any threats in this area on the way back. *cough*...

20140507.text: Are you alright there buddy? You're looking slightly the worse for wear.

20140508.text: I'm fine, it's nothing. I must've caught a cold a couple days ago while I was out at sea.

20140509.text: On my way past, I heard that someone had just arrived on the island to investigate, so I thought I'd come and take a look.

20140510.text: If there'd been some real danger, I might've had the chance to be the hero... Heh, shame it was just you guys. Guess I came here for nothing.

20140511.text: Teppei, don't you think there's something strange about this place?

20140512.text: Hmm... now that you mention it, there is something a little off about it.

20140513.text: It could be that the Tatarigami is more palpable here, I guess. We're not that far away from Orobaxi's remains.

20140515.text: A god. Look, there's the corpse over there.

20140516.text: Aah! It's a gigantic snake skeleton. It looks terrifying!

20140517.text: Orobaxi was the one who brought our ancestors from Enkanomiya up to the surface. That's the origin of the Watatsumi Island you know today.

20140518.text: Our ancestors regarded it as a guardian deity, but during the Archon War, Orobaxi invaded Yashiori Island.

20140519.text: The Raiden Shogun came out in person and slew Orobaxi with the Musou no Hitotachi. That same slash also formed what later became known as Musoujin Gorge.

20140520.text: The Raiden Shogun created Musoujin Gorge in one slash? Wow, that's pretty incredible...

20140521.text: Yes. But the Archon War was brutal... *cough* and Yashiori Island was completely destroyed during that battle. They say the shogun lost something very dear to her along the way too.

20140522.text: Since Orobaxi's death... *cough* there has always been some animosity between Watatsumi Island and the Shogunate. But our different beliefs have nothing to do with why the resistance was formed. We only rose up to fight against the Vision Hunt Decree.

20140523.text: When Orobaxi attacked civilization, the shogun stood up and put a stop to it.

20140524.text: But now that the shogun is stripping people of their ambitions with the Vision Hunt Decree, it's time for someone to stand up and stop the shogun... *cough*

20140525.text: Alright, I'm heading back. I was just dealing with some of the Shogun's elite samurai, so I think I'm gonna take a quick breather, then it's onto my next assignment.

20140526.text: You should report back to Sangonomiya as soon as possible. Don't stay here longer than you need to — being around the Tatarigami too long won't do your health any good...

20140530.text: Hey, don't worry about me. Peak condition...

20140531.text: Teppei's sure made some big progress if he's already dealing with Shogunate Samurai. Paimon can hardly believe it.

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to headquarters and talk to Sangonomiya Kokomi

20140601.text: Kokomi, we're back— Oh, look, Gorou's here too.

20140602.text: What happened? They look so serious...

20140603.text: Approximately how many people are exhibiting these symptoms?

20140604.text: I haven't had the chance to do a full count yet...

20140606.text: #Recently, {NICKNAME}, some of our soldiers started showing symptoms of accelerated aging.

20140607.text: I called them in for questioning and found out that they'd privately acquired some secret weapons from our sponsor.

20140608.text: Most of them are highly ambitious types, vehemently opposed to the Vision Hunt Decree. They've been using these new weapons secretly since getting hold of them.

20140609.text: So that's why the war has been going unusually well... But risky secret weapons are not the answer. We must put a stop to it immediately.

20140610.text: Gorou, have you managed to acquire one of these weapons?

20140611.text: Most of the officers refused to hand them over. Still, I did manage to get one...

20140613.text: #{NICKNAME}, do you know something about this?

20140615.text: So that means our secret sponsor is the Fatui?

20140616.text: But why would the Fatui do this...

20140617.text: Forget that, there's no time. Right now, we need to inform the whole army to cease using their Delusions immediately.

20140618.text: All soldiers who have shown symptoms are to be taken for treatment. I just hope we'll be in time to save them.

20140619.text: #Wait a second... {NICKNAME}, speaking of soldiers with symptoms...

20140622.text: Uhh, let's go check on him!

20140802.text: Oh... *cough* Hey, guys. What're you doing here?

20140803.text: Just a moment, lemme get up... Oof, it's weird, I don't know where all my strength's gone...

20140807.text: Oh right, yeah, I haven't had time to give you the full details. Well, I've made a lot of great contributions to the war effort lately.

20140808.text: Fighting the Shogun's Army at sea, taking on Shogunate Samurai all by myself, rescuing my comrades fr—from an ambush... things I never would have dreamed I could do when you first met me.

20140809.text: *cough* If only I were stronger still. The stronger I am, the more I can do for the resistance... Wait a sec, where's my secret weapon gone?

20145001.text: Gorou, let's go to the resistance camp ourselves. The use of Delusions has to stop right away.

400641101.text: It was a great pleasure to enjoy a delicious meal to the gentle whisper of the sea breeze. Thank you for making dinner for everyone, Xinyan.

400641102.text: No problem. I'm just glad y'all enjoyed it. I was real worried that I hadn't made enough for everyone... or that I'd made too much.

400641103.text: By the way, how was your walk today? Find any high-up spots with a good view?

400641104.text: Yes. The bard's description of an "emerald isle" describes this place perfectly.

400641105.text: Oh? So what about the rest of the story, is that true as well?

400641106.text: It's hard to say. But I do believe it.

400641107.text: Well then, let's hope we wake up tomorrow morning to the sight of the Dodo-King or a Dodoco! That'd be fun.

400641108.text: ...Of course, I don't mind if that doesn't happen. It's amazing just to be here on the island from the story, and to get to make some friends from Mondstadt.

400641201.text: The mortal temptations stopped the truth in its tracks, denying the verdict of my victory the chance to be announced in my presence.

400641202.text: Wow, I'm surprised you have the nerve to bring that up again.

400641203.text: #You and Oz are like two peas in a pod, trying desperately to convince {NICKNAME} and Paimon that you were the victor. I hardly see how that's fair.

400641204.text: Besides, only the loser would want to get—

400641206.text: Mein Fräulein, she means to say that you are the loser.

400641208.text: Ahem... Lady Megistus, let us put aside the sacred matter of our trial for now. Once I have reclaimed my throne in the Immernachtreich, we shall settle this for good in the Garten Sanssouci!

400641209.text: Oh, that's fine by me, I'll beat you no matter how many times you ask for a rematch... wait, but what is that place, exactly?

400641302.text: Ugh... Guess I shouldn't get too close to the cats after all... I'll just stay on the roof.

400670701.text: Hmm... I wonder what's really going on with my scryglass...

400670702.text: Leave all further observations to the expert! I'll inform you if anything comes up. Mm-hmm, nice working with you.

400670801.text: Kazuha seems pretty chill, and Her Highness has Mona to watch out for her, so we don't need to worry too much.

400670802.text: #As for you, {NICKNAME}... you're rockin' it as always, just like I am!

400670901.text: "I wander like the autumn leaves that float to the mountains and seas afar."

400670902.text: Though I am still on my journey, my perspective has changed greatly since I first wrote that poem.

400679917.text: The life of a wanderer is full of hardships. I have asked myself these questions many times:

400679918.text: Should I go? If so, where to, and by what means?

400679919.text: But I have no choice. The boundless world is calling out to me.

400679920.text: Farewell, my dear grandfather and father.

400679921.text: A final farewell, for I do not believe I will ever return to Inazuma.

400679922.text: But if one day, I do return...

400700101.text: What kind of mirage would Fischl not want to confront?

400700102.text: Could it be... that a swarm of phantoms will emerge, each claiming to be the true Fischl von Luftschloss Narfidort, Sovereign of the Immernachtreich, and ruler of the Ashen Darkness...

400700103.text: And then they'll immediately start arguing with each other in their completely incomprehensible language... eek.

400700104.text: Forget that, I shouldn't scare myself...

400700201.text: The melody from my mirage is still playing in my head. That was such an incredible experience!

400700202.text: I was able to make my wish come true, but I'm not sure if everyone else will have as good an experience as I did...

400700203.text: Let's get some rest so we'll have enough energy! Whatever happens, I should do everything I can to help my friends.

400700301.text: I didn't bring it up at the time since I didn't want to cause anyone any more distress... still, the disappearance of the Fatui worries me.

400700302.text: From the look on your face... I see, it appears we have similar thoughts.

400700303.text: Then let's stay diligent, and keep an eye out for any further developments.

400700602.text: It feels good to shout out your motto at the top of your voice.

400700701.text: Shh... calm your mind and listen carefully.

400700702.text: Can you hear it? The ocean, the sky, and the mountains... everything in the world has its own unique song.

400709901.text: Okay, this ought to do the trick.

400709902.text: There is a sound coming from the island.

400709903.text: Kazuha, can you feel the wind? Which direction is it blowing in?

400709904.text: It's coming from that direction. I'll take you to a hill where the wind blows.

400709905.text: Whoa! Where did they come from!?

400730101.text: Anyway, Oz... um... I, uh, ahem... thank you.

400730102.text: Mein Fräulein, I was merely doing my duty. You need not thank me. Rather, it's my honor to follow you.

400730103.text: Then I shall grant you the honor of accompanying me to the performance.

400730301.text: Fischl's dilemma was indeed within herself. But there was only one phantom, not a swarm... so my guess was a little off the mark.

400730302.text: After all that she went through, it's good that she finally got to reconcile with herself.

400730303.text: Still, it looks like I won't be free from this Court Archmage role anytime soon...

400730501.text: Fischl's rebuttal totally rocked! It was so dramatic and so powerful! I didn't want to interrupt her, or I would've started blasting out a backing track!

400730502.text: The stage is set up and everyone's here together. Love this feeling!

400730503.text: Let's celebrate this special occasion together!

400730701.text: "On the homeward road, ravens soar into the sky..."

400730702.text: Although the mirages are essentially independent, I believe there is some connection.

400730703.text: The final line... but of course, "Rainbow greets my eye."

400739901.text: "...spoke amid a downpour of the dragon's blood. She said, 'May my people be freed from the shackles of ancient decrees.'"

400739902.text: Such wise and compassionate words could only come from your own writing, mein Fräulein.

400739903.text: Hmph, yet this kingdom appears to be anything but what I've described. The shadows lurking behind the scenes are disconcerting...

400739904.text: "Prinzessin Fischl again continued her song, and the interwoven chords of her sacred words became the Immernachtreich's hymn."

400739905.text: "She picked up mere stones to carve out mountains and oceans, before bestowing upon her people castles and towns."

400739906.text: "My magnificent kingdom is a small and forbidden paradise."

400739913.text: There's the book! Let's go and close it.

400739914.text: Let's hope we won't get transported to another strange place this time...

400770301.text: Hehe, greetings, my most loyal attendant.

400770303.text: Why, certainly. I bestow upon thee permission to ask any questions.

400770305.text: O, thou whose fate doth intersect with mine own, please enjoy thyself fully in this paradise.

400770401.text: Is this the end of our vacation...

400770403.text: Sure, is there something you wanted to ask me?

400770405.text: Mmm, make sure to enjoy yourself before leaving this island.

400770501.text: I've got some new inspiration for a song...

400770505.text: Okay, make sure to take it easy.

400770601.text: The sound of nature is so relaxing. There's nothing more to worry about...

400770605.text: You must be tired from the past few days. Take a well-deserved rest.

400779903.text: We've found all the crystalline cores. Let's put them back into the machine!
